CHAPTER 6 · ITEM 04 / 12

Price ceilings and floors

Minimum wage and employment最低工資與就業

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Apply a minimum wage to the labor market: workers supply labor, firms demand labor, employment is labor demanded at a binding wage floor, and unemployment is labor supplied minus labor demanded.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

工人供應勞工，企業需求勞工。最低工資高於均衡時，就業取企業需求量，圖中的失業為勞工供給減需求。

Workers supply labor and firms demand it. At a binding minimum wage, employment equals labor demanded and unemployment in this simple diagram equals labor supplied minus labor demanded.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：At the wage floor, 120 workers want jobs and firms hire 80. Employment=80 and unemployment=40. 想工作的人不等於成功就業者。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

At the minimum wage Ls=100 and Ld=70. Employment? 就業人數？
